scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && for file in lib/*.mjs public/blogger.js; do node --check "$file"; done
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run check:openapi && npm run test:node && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:engine
scripts.test:engine: cd engine && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -c pytest.ini tests -m 'not live' -q
scripts.test:engine:live: cd engine && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -c pytest.ini tests -m live -v -s
